changes.quote: They standardised on the NS-500 controller across two plants in 2025.

content.text:
The knowledge base shows no contractual NS-500 discount for Acme Manufacturing (recorded as "Acme Mfg. Holdings") on 2022-10-01. No Acme facts at all are valid on that date.

- **The earliest contract started later.** The first contractual discount on record is a "may receive" fact for the NS-500 Industrial Controller. It runs from 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31 and seems to come from the contract ACME-SA-2023. So it began six months after the date you asked about.
- **Later records don't reach back to 2022.** The Acme NS-500 Strategic Account Exception replaces an earlier exception, EXC-ACME-NS500-10. It was approved by David Morgan on 2025-03-20, and Acme signed on 2025-03-22. There's also an undated "eligible for discounts of up to" fact. Neither applies to 2022.
- **No percentages are stored.** None of the discount records includes an actual rate. The "10" in EXC-ACME-NS500-10 might mean 10%, but that's only a guess from the name, and that exception isn't dated to 2022 either.

On this record, no contractual cap was in force on 2022-10-01. If there was an earlier agreement, it hasn't been added to the knowledge base. To get actual rates, check the source contract and exception documents directly.
